patthana21.38:1.1: na sahetukaṃ na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ahetuko sanidassanasappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: ekaṃ.
patthana21.38:2.1: na ahetukaṃ na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ahetuko sanidassanasappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: ekaṃ. gaṇitakena tīṇi pañhā.
patthana21.38:4.1: na sahetukaṃ na anidassanaappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ahetuko anidassanaappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā ekaṃ.
